name: Ratio-constrained non-HDL tail pairing stress tests

a.description: Lower-tail-count assignment: rearrange HDL among fixed TC records to reduce the number with non-HDL >=160 mg/dL, subject to the ratio and physiological-order constraints.

b.description: Higher-tail-count assignment: rearrange HDL among fixed TC records to increase the number with non-HDL >=160 mg/dL, subject to the same constraints.

interpretation: Finite-search, oppositely directed mathematical sensitivity scenarios, not proven global bounds, fitted biological mechanisms, or target-population estimates. No threshold fraction is specified as a calibration target.
